title: stack, queue and deque in C++
summary: The three sequence adaptors, their O(1) operations, and when a deque replaces both.

sections.title: API
Which to use
sections.body:
✍️ LIFO (last in, first out: undo, brackets, DFS) → `stack`.
✍️ FIFO (first in, first out: BFS, processing order) → `queue`.
✍️ Need both ends (sliding window max, 0-1 BFS) → `deque`.
- A `vector` with `push_back`/`back`/`pop_back` works as a stack and lets you iterate it; many solutions use it instead of `stack`.
